readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
The temple struck eleven while Lina was still in the kitchen with Rosa
The kitchen clock showed this when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: 13 minutes of piano playing (from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Rosa stayed in the kitchen for the whole evening
Rosa was kept out of the dining room with the gentlemen, by Madame's rule
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven
Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen
Madame was playing the piano from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock (heard by Rosa in the kitchen)
Rosa went up to the atelier to fetch Monsieur for the toast
Rosa saw Monsieur on the floor by his bench in the atelier
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier and came down them again
Rosa did not stop anywhere on the stairs or on the way
